source: SCMDB public mining dataset and resource guide
scope: Human-readable names, system and location type only. Spawn groups, weights, compositions and qualities are extracted independently from the local game.
visibility: Omit unlocated/internal presets by default, following the SCMDB resource guide and Bedrock's documented curation. Hidden presets remain inspectable; this is curation, not proof that a game record is unreachable.
excluded: Three supplementary entries without preset GUIDs are not represented as local game-file facts.
